Sir Stewart die for im home for Los Angeles on Wednesday afta brief battle wit Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia, di actor Instagram account announce on Thursday.
Dem say e bin dey "in di loving care of im beloved wife Sunny".
BBC Culture Correspondent Noor Nanji write say Sir Patrick Stewart bin appeal to different generations sake of im roles for multi-generational franchises.
Younger sci-fi and comic book fans go don discover im work on streaming platforms.
For 2019, im bin act for one modern-day Merlin, wey bring di famous tale to new audiences.
And one of di tins wey im go dey remembered for na im encouragement for young artists, as e dey ginger dem to "dey brave" and trust odas.
"If I bin do am earlier for my life, maybe evritin for don change," im bin tell Esquire few years ago.
